endpoints.summary: List one page of a resolved directory
endpoints.description: Returns a bounded, sorted page of a directory previously resolved by Resolve, keyed by its opaque preview id. Entries are classified from their extension alone so a page costs no file reads. Pages are capped (1000 max, 200 default) and the scan stops at fifty-thousand entries; size and date sorts are limited to 5000 entries and downgrade to a name sort with a warning above that. The continuation token pins the directory mtime, so a directory that changes mid-walk aborts rather than silently skipping entries.

errors.description: Missing session_id/preview_id, or a page token that does not match the requested directory, sort, or filter
Unknown/expired preview id or the directory no longer exists
Directory changed between pages; the listing must be reloaded
Preview id does not name a directory

endpoints.summary: Stream the bytes of a resolved preview
endpoints.description: Serves the file bytes for an opaque, session-bound preview id with HTTP Range support (206/Content-Range/Accept-Ranges, 416 on bad range) and HEAD. Content-Type comes from the resolved metadata; no-store + nosniff. Re-stats the file and returns 409 if it changed since resolve. Consumed directly by native /

errors.description: Unknown/expired preview id or session mismatch
File changed since the preview was resolved; reopen to refresh

rest_exception.note: Byte-range blob stream consumed by native browser media elements without a generated client — the same browser-native-transport category as terminal_ws. Connect's wire format cannot express opaque byte streaming with Range. The opaque preview id (never a raw path) is issued by FilePreviewService.Resolve and bound to the session.
